Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that will help target muscle tension (and tightness) that may be leading to neck pain and headaches.

This exercise is perfect to do throughout the day, especially when you start to notice pain or a headache. It requires no equipment, and may give relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
